name: PHELLANDRIUM AQUATICUM
key_symptoms: Sticking pain through right breast near sternum, extending to back near shoulders. Dyspnœa, and continuous cough, early in morning. Cough, with profuse and fetid expectoration; compels him to sit up. Hoarseness.
Weight on vertex; aching and burning in temples and above eyes. Crushing feeling in vertex. Vertigo, dizzy when lying down.

urinary_symptoms: Pain in milk ducts; intolerable between nursing. Pain in nipples.
fever_symptoms: Hectic; profuse and debilitating perspiration; intermittent, with pain in arms. Desire for acids.
